Naderi Sends Rangers to Premier Sports Cup Final with Late Winner Against Aberdeen

01 Nov 2026, 06:20 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Sports Desk · Source: www.theguardian.com

2 min read

Key takeawaysRyan Naderi scored a dramatic late goal in the 83rd minute to secure a 1-0 victory for Rangers against Aberdeen, sending his side through to the Premier Sports Cup final at Hampden Park.

Late Breakthrough at Hampden Park

Ryan Naderi scored a dramatic late goal in the 83rd minute to secure a 1-0 victory for Rangers against Aberdeen, sending his side through to the Premier Sports Cup final at Hampden Park.

Aberdeen deployed a makeshift lineup due to five defensive players missing through suspension or injury. Despite restricting Rangers to a single shot on target in a low-quality first half, Aberdeen faced mounting pressure after the interval before finally conceding late in the match.

Match Highlights and Tactical Shifts

  • The Decisive Goal: In the 83rd minute, James Penrice fired toward goal, and Naderi redirected the strike past the goalkeeper for his eighth goal of the season.
  • Aberdeen Resilience: Despite being forced into tactical adjustments and an early substitution after Emmanuel Gyamfi sustained an injury tackling Kim Min-su, Aberdeen's defense held firm under sustained pressure for much of the second half.
  • Missed Chances: Both sides created opportunities as the game stretched, with Rangers' Kevin Kelsy heading past the post from close range and Aberdeen threatening through Kevin Nisbet.

Post-Match Comments

Following the game, match-winner Naderi expressed delight with the result while remaining modest about his close-range scoring proficiency.

"It feels amazing. I’m happy, of course, happy to be the one who scores the goals, but happy for the team," Naderi said. Commenting on his attempts from distance, he joked: "I’ve tried to shoot twice today from outside of the box and it didn’t go well. So I went back inside the box. Maybe I should just stick to the easy ones!"

Next Steps

  • The Final: Rangers will face the winners of the semi-final between Hearts and Hibernian.
